item.title: Hida Tofu & Dengaku: The Firm Mountain Tofu of the Hida Region — Guide
item.description: Hida tofu is a notably firm, dense style of tofu made in the mountainous Hida region using the area’s cold, clean water, traditionally pressed harder and made sturdier than typical tofu so it could withstand the region’s cold winters and be handled and cooked more robustly. A classic way to enjoy it is dengaku, in which the tofu is skewered, coated with a sweet-savoury miso glaze and grilled over charcoal, and it also features in the region’s simmered and hotpot dishes, offering a hearty, warming taste of Hida mountain cuisine.
